claims.text: Ethambutol 15–25 mg/kg (max 2.5 g) PO daily; best tolerated.
claims.quote: Ethambutol (EMB) dosage is 15 to 25 mg/kg (maximum 2.5 g) orally typically once/day and is the best-tolerated of the first-line medications

claims.text: Main toxicity optic neuritis (higher doses, renal impairment); first sign is blue-green color confusion.
claims.quote: Its main potential toxicity is optic neuritis, which is more common at higher doses (eg, 25 mg/kg) and in patients with impaired renal function. Initial symptoms of optic neuritis are an inability to distinguish blue from green

claims.text: Baseline color vision and acuity, then monthly questioning;
claims.quote: patients should have a baseline test of color vision and visual acuity, and monitoring should include monthly questions regarding their vision.
